notes.title: New Hand-Drawn Motion Comics Horror Game - Lazarus A.D. 2222
notes.content:
From today you can add a new game from Sons of Welder, published by Polyslash, to the wishlist on Steam.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2451460

Lazarus A.D. 2222 is the last part of the Sons of Welder game series, set in a dystopian universe that uniquely combines games from the Magnus series.
A game that you can experience on two levels. Hand-drawn motion comics horror. A metaphor of a journey into oneself. A mystical experience with an addition of good humor.

The big advantage of the game, in an increasingly automated world, is that all graphics in the game are drawn by the authors.
The game was created by real people, for people :)
